proof_body:
by
  intro a b c R s hR ha hb hne hs hk
  set p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a with hp
  have hrad : 0 < p.radius := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, hrR⟩ := exists_between hR
    have hsum : Summable (fun n => ‖p n‖ * r ^ n) := by
      have h := (ha (c + (r : ℂ)) (by simpa [abs_of_pos hr0] using hrR)).norm
      refine h.congr (fun n => ?_)
      simp [hp, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_norm, abs_of_pos hr0]
    have := p.le_radius_of_summable (r := r.toNNReal) (by rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hr0.le]; exact hsum)
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ this
    exact ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hr0)
  have h1 := (p.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hrad).comp_sub c
  simp only [zero_add] at h1
  have e : (fun z => p.sum (z - c)) = fun w => ∑' k, a k * (w - c) ^ k := by
    funext w
    simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.sum]
    congr 1
    funext k
    simpa [hp] using FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq (E := ℂ) a (w - c) k
  rw [e] at h1
  set q := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ b with hq
  have hrad2 : 0 < q.radius := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, hrR⟩ := exists_between hR
    have hsum2 : Summable (fun n => ‖q n‖ * r ^ n) := by
      have h := (hb (c + (r : ℂ)) (by simpa [abs_of_pos hr0] using hrR)).norm
      refine h.congr (fun n => ?_)
      simp [hq, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_norm, abs_of_pos hr0]
    have := q.le_radius_of_summable (r := r.toNNReal) (by rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hr0.le]; exact hsum2)
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ this
    exact ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hr0)
  have h2 := (q.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hrad2).comp_sub c
  simp only [zero_add] at h2
  have e2 : (fun z => q.sum (z - c)) = fun w => ∑' k, b k * (w - c) ^ k := by
    funext w
    simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.sum]
    congr 1
    funext k
    simpa [hq] using FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq (E := ℂ) b (w - c) k
  rw [e2] at h2
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, (∑' k, a k * (z - c) ^ k) = ∑' k, b k * (z - c) ^ k := by
    have hs' : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hs, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hne⟩
    have hf : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, (∑' k, a k * (z - c) ^ k) = ∑' k, b k * (z - c) ^ k :=
      hs'.frequently (Filter.Frequently.of_forall hk)
    exact (h1.hasFPowerSeriesAt.analyticAt.frequently_eq_iff_eventually_eq h2.hasFPowerSeriesAt.analyticAt).mp hf
  have h5 := h1.hasFPowerSeriesAt.eq_formalMultilinearSeries_of_eventually h2.hasFPowerSeriesAt hev
  exact FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_series_injective ℂ ℂ h5
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℂ), 0 < R → (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w - c‖ < R → Summable (fun n => a n * (w - c) ^ n)) → (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w - c‖ < R → Summable (fun n => b n * (w - c) ^ n)) → (∀ k, s k ≠ c) → Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds c) → (∀ k, ∑' n, a n * (s k - c) ^ n = ∑' n, b n * (s k - c) ^ n) → a = b
